name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Tankers hit in Hormuz on 5 Nov; US officials say forces are poised to resume major combat
state: Iran said several tankers hit mines in Hormuz on 5 Nov, and Pentagon officials told the New York Times that thousands of US forces are poised to resume major combat against Iran on Trump's orders (Al Jazeera). US strikes hit an air-defence site on Qeshm Island on 3 Nov (Stars and Stripes). Iran demands an end to the US blockade and sanctions relief.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which can change quickly.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states; Hormuz substantially closed

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran says tankers struck in Hormuz amid fears of new US attack
Stars and Stripes — US quietly strikes Iranian island in Strait of Hormuz

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
